portmarlowe.options.title: Port Marlowe: iPhone Performance
portmarlowe.preset.max_performance.toolt: Fast graphics, smooth lighting off, render distance 4-8 (by memory), simulation 5, no clouds, no biome blend, no mipmaps, minimal particles, no entity shadows, 60 FPS cap, no menu blur. Only lowers settings, never raises them.
portmarlowe.preset.balanced.tooltip: Fast graphics, smooth lighting kept, render distance 6-10 (by memory), fast clouds, biome blend 1, 2 mipmap levels, decreased particles, 60 FPS cap, no menu blur. Only lowers settings, never raises them.
portmarlowe.options.dynamic_fps.tooltip: Lower the frame rate when nobody can tell (menus, background, AFK). A cooler phone throttles less, so gameplay stays fast for longer and the battery lasts.
portmarlowe.options.menu_fps.tooltip: Frame-rate cap while a menu or inventory is open. Chat keeps the full frame rate.
portmarlowe.options.idle_fps.tooltip: Frame-rate cap after the idle timeout without any touch, key or controller input.
portmarlowe.options.idle_timeout.tooltip: How long without input before Idle FPS kicks in.
portmarlowe.options.unfocused_fps.toolti: Frame-rate cap while the game is not in focus.
portmarlowe.options.particle_culling.too: Skip particles that are outside the camera's view instead of building their geometry every frame.
portmarlowe.options.particle_limit.toolt: Maximum number of live particles. Explosions, farms and campfires can otherwise create thousands.
portmarlowe.options.block_entity_distanc: How far away chests, signs, banners, heads and beds are drawn. Vanilla uses 64 blocks. Beacon beams are not affected.
portmarlowe.options.ambient_effects.tool: How many random nearby blocks are checked each tick for torch smoke, drips, fire crackle and similar effects.
portmarlowe.options.texture_animations.t: Water, lava, fire and portal animations. Turning them off saves a texture upload per animation frame.
portmarlowe.options.chunk_builder_thread: Parallel chunk meshing threads; each one keeps several MB of native memory. Auto picks 3 on phones (1 with Sodium). Takes effect after a restart.
portmarlowe.options.auto_preset.tooltip: Apply the selected preset automatically the first time the game starts on a phone.
